1.mascotDialogue: Once expression become tree, evaluating simple — solve both children, then apply operator at parent. No precedence table needed at evaluation time. Shape already encode it.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 8, base case — leaf just return her digit. Lines 9 and 10 recurse into both children before line 11 combine them. Bottom of tree evaluate first, always.

3.mascotDialogue: Because plus sit beneath times, forced to resolve first — that's precedence, shown as depth in tree, instead of rule you must memorise.

4.mascotDialogue: This bug hide well precisely because multiplication don't care about order. Swap operator to subtraction in your head, and same exact shape start lying to you.
